mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_chat_run ( tenant_id, session_id, application_id, actor_id, client_message_id, command_hash, status, phase, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, fencing_token, attempt_count, finalization_attempt_count, finalization_cycle_attempt_count, manual_replay_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{applicationId}, #{actorId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{commandHash}, #{status}, #{phase}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{fencingToken}, #{attemptCount}, #{finalizationAttemptCount}, #{finalizationCycleAttemptCount}, #{manualReplayCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, session_id, client_message_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, tenant_id, session_id, application_id, actor_id, client_message_id, command_hash, status, phase, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, fencing_token, attempt_count, finalization_attempt_count, finalization_cycle_attempt_count, manual_replay_count, finalization_json::text AS finalization_json, result_json::text AS result_json, failure_code, failure_summary, failure_trace_id, last_replay_request_id, last_replay_reason, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM app_chat_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND client_message_id = #{clientMessageId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT run_id, tenant_id, session_id, application_id, actor_id, client_message_id, command_hash, status, phase, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, fencing_token, attempt_count, finalization_attempt_count, finalization_cycle_attempt_count, manual_replay_count, finalization_json::text AS finalization_json, result_json::text AS result_json, failure_code, failure_summary, failure_trace_id, last_replay_request_id, last_replay_reason, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM app_chat_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId} FOR UPDATE

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT tenant_id, run_id, lease_owner, fencing_token FROM app_chat_run WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND phase = 'RESULT_RECEIVED' AND finalization_json IS NOT NULL AND finalization_cycle_attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND lease_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY lease_expires_at, run_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE app_chat_run AS run SET lease_owner = #{newLeaseOwner}, lease_expires_at = #{newLeaseExpiresAt}, fencing_token = run.fencing_token + 1, attempt_count = run.attempt_count + 1, finalization_attempt_count = run.finalization_attempt_count + 1, finalization_cycle_attempt_count = run.finalization_cycle_attempt_count + 1, updated_at = #{now} FROM candidates WHERE run.tenant_id = candidates.tenant_id AND run.run_id = candidates.run_id AND run.lease_owner = candidates.lease_owner AND run.fencing_token = candidates.fencing_token AND run.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND run.phase = 'RESULT_RECEIVED' AND run.finalization_json IS NOT NULL AND run.finalization_cycle_attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND run.lease_expires_at <= #{now} RETURNING run.run_id, run.tenant_id, run.session_id, run.application_id, run.actor_id, run.client_message_id, run.command_hash, run.status, run.phase, run.lease_owner, run.lease_expires_at, run.fencing_token, run.attempt_count, run.finalization_attempt_count, run.finalization_cycle_attempt_count, run.manual_replay_count, run.finalization_json::text AS finalization_json, run.result_json::text AS result_json, run.failure_code, run.failure_summary, run.failure_trace_id, run.last_replay_request_id, run.last_replay_reason, run.completed_at, run.created_at, run.updated_at
mapper.update: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT tenant_id, run_id FROM app_chat_run WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND phase = 'RESULT_RECEIVED' AND finalization_json IS NOT NULL AND finalization_cycle_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} AND lease_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY lease_expires_at, run_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE app_chat_run AS run SET status = 'DEAD_LETTER', failure_code = COALESCE(run.failure_code, #{failureCode}), failure_summary = COALESCE(run.failure_summary, #{failureSummary}), failure_trace_id = COALESCE(run.failure_trace_id, #{traceId}), updated_at = #{now} FROM candidates WHERE run.tenant_id = candidates.tenant_id AND run.run_id = candidates.run_id AND run.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND run.phase = 'RESULT_RECEIVED' AND run.finalization_json IS NOT NULL AND run.finalization_cycle_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} AND run.lease_expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, tenant_id, session_id, application_id, actor_id, client_message_id, command_hash, status, phase, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, fencing_token, attempt_count, finalization_attempt_count, finalization_cycle_attempt_count, manual_replay_count, finalization_json::text AS finalization_json, result_json::text AS result_json, failure_code, failure_summary, failure_trace_id, last_replay_request_id, last_replay_reason, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM app_chat_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'DEAD_LETTER' AND phase = 'RESULT_RECEIVED' AND finalization_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_chat_run SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', lease_owner = #{newLeaseOwner}, lease_expires_at = #{newLeaseExpiresAt}, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, finalization_attempt_count = finalization_attempt_count + 1, finalization_cycle_attempt_count = 1, manual_replay_count = manual_replay_count + 1, last_replay_request_id = #{replayRequestId}, last_replay_reason = #{reason}, failure_code = NULL, failure_summary = NULL, failure_trace_id = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'DEAD_LETTER' AND phase = 'RESULT_RECEIVED' AND finalization_json IS NOT NULL AND (last_replay_request_id IS NULL OR last_replay_request_id <> #{replayRequestId})
